sources.note: Main homepage. Describes RevolutionEHR as cloud-based EHR for optometry, 13,000+ eye care professionals, 97% retention, 4.48 stars across 838 reviews. Lists core features and Rev add-on modules (RevAspire, RevBilling, RevClear, RevDirect, RevEngage, RevIntake, RevPayments).

ONC certification disclosure page. Confirms CHPL ID 15.04.04.1591.Revo.07.00.1.181231, version 7, certified 2018-12-31. Lists integrated modules, FHIR API, single and population-level export, e-prescribing via RXNT, 9 certified CQMs. Notes additional fees for RevDirect and RXNT.

EHR solutions page. Describes clinical documentation, billing/claims, scheduling, optical POS, patient engagement. Mentions multi-location support, staff role customization, diagnostic device integration.
Specialties page. Describes support for low vision care, vision therapy, and mobile/home-based care (nursing home visits). Emphasizes customizable exam templates for specialty workflows.

Integrations page. Lists 30+ integrations across 7 categories: claims processing (ABB Verify, Aloha, Ensora/APEX EDI, RevClear/TriZetto), equipment (Canon, Essilor, Marco, Optos, Optovue, Reichert, TopCon, Zeiss, etc.), patient communication (Weave, SolutionReach, DemandForce, etc.), payments (Global Payments), analytics (ABB Analyze, EDGEPro), practice management (ABB OneBill, EyeCarePro, IntakeQ), prescribing/ordering (ABB Optical, Arrellio, HOYA, RXNT, VisionWeb).
Blog post about integrated optometry EHR. Found via search; describes the value of having EHR, billing, scheduling, and optical in one system.

Blog about SmartFLOW contact lens ordering integration. Describes direct connections with CooperVision, Hoya, ABB Optical Group for automated contact lens ordering, parameter verification, pricing, and order status tracking.
Blog about optical order management. Describes frame/lens ordering workflows, supplier connections (OOGP, VisionWeb, Arrellio), dispensing tool integration (OptikamPad), inventory management.
Help center category for optical module. Confirms optical dispensing, ordering, and inventory management features exist in the product (page not fully fetched but category structure visible).

Capterra reviews (accessed via search snippets; direct page blocked). Users praise customization, optometry-specific design, integrated billing/scheduling/optical. Common complaints: too many clicks per encounter, slow for complex cases, limited third-party integrations. Confirms users handle exams, optical, scheduling, and billing all within the system.

Eyes on Eyecare article about Rev360. Describes Rev360 as the parent company delivering RevolutionEHR plus business services including patient engagement, product ordering, image management, quality reporting, and education.
Eyes on Eyecare overview of RevolutionEHR. Describes it as eyecare software for many modalities.
PEAK Technology Partners deal page confirming RevolutionEHR acquired by RevOptix in October 2014.
Madison.com article about RevOptix investing $45 million in RevolutionEHR/Rev360 between 2014 and 2016.

RevCycle Partners spin-out announcement. Confirms RevCycle Partners (billing/revenue cycle services) was formerly part of RevolutionEHR/Rev360 and spun out as an independent company. Page content not fully accessible.
Third-party guide to RevolutionEHR features and pricing. Page content not fully accessible but confirms the product is positioned as optometry-specific with features, pricing, and pros/cons analysis.
VisionWeb integration page for RevolutionEHR. Confirms optical ordering integration between RevolutionEHR and VisionWeb for frames and lenses.
